records.stdout:
Build projects from shared layers

Usage: hydragen [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init  Initialise a layer in the current directory
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --non-interactive  Never prompt, even in a terminal
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version

Initialise a layer in the current directory

Usage: hydragen init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --name <NAME>                Optional name override (defaults to the current directory name; must not be blank)
      --non-interactive            Never prompt, even in a terminal
      --author <AUTHOR>            Optional person or organisation credited with authoring the layer
      --description <DESCRIPTION>  Optional explanation of what the layer provides or is used for
  -h, --help                       Print help

Examples:
  hydragen init
  hydragen init --name shared-agent-rules
  hydragen init --name shared-agent-rules --author "Example team" --description "Shared coding-agent instructions."
  hydragen init --non-interactive --name shared-agent-rules

No metadata flags: guided prompts when stdin, stdout and stderr are terminals and CI is disabled.
Any metadata flag: flag-only input; no follow-up questions.
Name defaults to the current directory name when omitted. Author and description are optional.
--non-interactive always disables prompts.
